name: stride-ideation
description: Turn an idea into shipped Stride tasks. Two slash commands — /stride-ideation:ideate (interactive ideation session producing a committed requirements doc; supports --profile lean|product|discovery|lean-startup to select the round structure and reviewer rubric) and /stride-ideation:stridify (decomposes the requirements into a Stride batch JSON, commits it for audit, and POSTs it to the Stride API in one shot). Replaces superpowers:brainstorming for projects that use Stride.
